run_whitebox_attack: run a white-box adversarial attack on a text classification model using gumbel-softmax optimization
run_attack_with_cw_loss: run the adversarial attack using the Carlini-Wagner loss to fool a BERT classifier
run_attack_with_bertscore_constraint: run the white-box attack with a bertscore_idf constraint to preserve semantic similarity
run_attack_on_mnli: run the adversarial attack on the MNLI dataset targeting either premise or hypothesis
run_attack_on_classification_dataset: run the adversarial attack on dbpedia14, ag_news, imdb, or yelp classification datasets
